pages.summary: Tightened the native route introduction while preserving the manifest-table navigation and exact-build requirement.

Replaced the CI fixture exposition with a focused cancellable helper example, corrected the crate-local macro restriction, and documented location-dependent macro refusals. Removed commit hashes and retained author-facing rules and errors.
Removed fixture names, process notes, and the dated crash-report aside; simplified the examples and clarified cooldown behavior, slot tie ordering, type resolution, and panic unwinding.
